title: Old yearbooks
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, old brick adult night school after dark, flickering fluorescent classrooms and long empty hallways, chalk dust in the air, sickly green and sodium orange tones, adults only, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 2. He's in every staff photo since 1940. Unchanged. 📸

Original fiction. Part 3 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: a substitute named Mr. Grey covered Carla's night class, and every student remembered him except her.
scenes.image: a man in a grey suit at a chalkboard seen through a door window, fluorescent light

scenes.narration: Thursday, she got there an hour early. The room was empty. The board was clean. But the air was thick with chalk dust, as if someone had just finished erasing.
scenes.image: chalk dust hanging in the air of an empty classroom, a freshly wiped chalkboard

scenes.narration: Mr. Grey never showed. Her students looked disappointed. Marisol, in the back row, whispered: he only comes when you're not here.
scenes.image: a middle-aged woman student in the back row whispering, her face half in shadow

scenes.narration: Eastgate was a high school once, before it became a night school. The basement archive kept every staff portrait since it opened.
scenes.image: a basement archive under a bare bulb, metal shelves of old leather-bound albums

scenes.narration: Nineteen forty. Rows of teachers in stiff collars. Back row, far left. Grey suit. Grey tie. The face she'd seen through the door.
scenes.image: a sepia group portrait of stern adult teachers, one man in a grey suit at the far edge in sharper focus

scenes.narration: Nineteen fifty-five. Same man. Same tie. Same age.
scenes.image: a black-and-white staff portrait of adult teachers, the same grey-suited man at the edge

scenes.narration: Seventy-one. Eighty-eight. Two thousand three. He never moved. He never aged. Always at the edge. Always half a step behind.
scenes.image: a faded color staff photograph of adult teachers, the same unchanged man standing slightly apart

scenes.narration: And in every photo, he stood exactly where a teacher should have been. He doesn't replace people. He replaces the space they leave.
scenes.image: close-up of an old photograph, a gap in a row of teachers filled by a pale man in grey

scenes.narration: The newest portrait was from last fall. Carla was in it. Front row. Smiling.
scenes.image: a modern staff portrait of adult teachers, a smiling woman with dark hair in the front row

scenes.narration: And standing right behind her, one hand resting on her shoulder, was Mr. Grey.
scenes.image: close-up of a photograph showing a grey-sleeved hand resting on a smiling woman's shoulder
